root_cause: The existing skill evidence validator was only a pure record-shape checker; daily jobs lacked an auditable observation of exact skill-file bytes read on the actual GitHub run. This is a missing CI audit observation, not an observed production false-success incident.
prevention: Read real skill files on the existing daily job, hash exact bytes and attach the run-bound artifact; never equate loaded bytes with agent application or independently authenticated provider proof.
prevention_rule: LOADED_BYTES_ONLY must never be promoted to VERIFIED_EVIDENCE without independent agent-specific assertions and verifier provenance.
